value: “Substantive” means the content meaning of a word, as distinct from the grammatical relation it marks. For example, “to use, to employ” is the content meaning of the Chinese word also used as a preposition. An “original substantive meaning” is an earlier content meaning that may later be lost; “substantive” does not mean “noun.”
